title: In silico prediction of the action of bromelain on PI3K/Akt signalling pathway to arrest nasopharyngeal cancer oncogenesis by targeting phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha protein.
authors: Shamsuri, Alyaa Syafiqah; Sim, Edmund Ui-Hang
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接预测菠萝蛋白酶与NPC相关蛋白（含PIK3CA等）的结合，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This research investigates the potential anti-tumour effects of bromelain, an aqueous extract from pineapple stems and fruits, on nasopharyngeal cancer (NPC). While bromelain is known for its medicinal properties in various cancers, its impact on NPC remains unexplored. RESULTS: Using in silico methods, we studied the predicted interactions between bromelain and key proteins involved in NPC oncogenesis, specifically beta-catenin, PIK3CA, mTOR, EGFR, and BCL2. Molecular docking strategies were performed using a myriad of computational tools. A 3D model of bromelain was constructed using SWISS-MODEL, followed by molecular docking simulations performed with ClusPro. The binding affinities of the docked complexes were evaluated using HawkDock, and the interactions were analysed with LigPlot+. The docking scores indicated potential spontaneous interactions, with binding affinities based on being - 103.89 kcal/mol (PIK3CA), -73.16 kcal/mol (EGFR), -71.18 kcal/mol (mTOR), -65.22 kcal/mol (beta-catenin), and - 57.48 kcal/mol (BCL2). LigPlot + analysis revealed the presence of hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic interactions, and salt bridges, indicating stable predicted interactions. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that bromelain can target key proteins involved in NPC oncogenesis, with the strongest affinity towards PIK3CA. This suggests a hypothetical insight into bromelain's anticancer effects on NPC through the modulation of the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究探讨菠萝蛋白酶（bromelain，一种从菠萝茎和果实中提取的水性提取物）对鼻咽癌（nasopharyngeal cancer, NPC）的潜在抗肿瘤作用。尽管菠萝蛋白酶在多种癌症中已知具有药用特性，但其对NPC的影响尚未被探索。结果：采用计算机模拟（in silico）方法，我们研究了菠萝蛋白酶与NPC肿瘤发生中关键蛋白（特别是β-连环蛋白 (beta-catenin)、PIK3CA、mTOR、EGFR 和 BCL2）之间的预测相互作用。分子对接策略使用了多种计算工具。使用SWISS-MODEL构建了菠萝蛋白酶的三维模型，随后使用ClusPro进行分子对接模拟。对接复合物的结合亲和力使用HawkDock评估，相互作用使用LigPlot+分析。对接分数表明存在潜在的自发相互作用，结合亲和力分别为-103.89 kcal/mol（PIK3CA）、-73.16 kcal/mol（EGFR）、-71.18 kcal/mol（mTOR）、-65.22 kcal/mol（β-连环蛋白）和-57.48 kcal/mol（BCL2）。LigPlot+分析揭示了氢键、疏水相互作用和盐桥的存在，表明预测的相互作用稳定。结论：我们的研究结果表明，菠萝蛋白酶可以靶向参与NPC肿瘤发生的关键蛋白，其中对PIK3CA的亲和力最强。这为菠萝蛋白酶通过调节PI3K/Akt信号通路对NPC产生抗癌作用提供了假设性见解。
